tools.name: mcp__filesystem__read_text_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file as text. Handles various text encodings. Use head or tail to read part of a file. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: mcp__filesystem__read_multiple_files
tools.description: Read the contents of multiple files simultaneously. Failed reads do not stop the whole operation.

tools.name: mcp__filesystem__write_file
tools.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content.

tools.name: mcp__filesystem__edit_file
tools.description: Make line-based edits to a text file. Each edit replaces exact line sequences. Returns a git-style diff.

dryRun.description: Preview changes using git-style diff format

tools.name: mcp__filesystem__create_directory
tools.description: Create a new directory or ensure a directory exists, including nested directories.

tools.name: mcp__filesystem__list_directory
tools.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path.

tools.name: mcp__filesystem__directory_tree
tools.description: Get a recursive tree view of files and directories as JSON.

tools.name: mcp__filesystem__move_file
tools.description: Move or rename files and directories.

tools.name: mcp__filesystem__search_files
tools.description: Recursively search for files and directories matching a pattern. Case-insensitive, returns full paths.

tools.name: mcp__filesystem__get_file_info
tools.description: Retrieve detailed metadata about a file or directory: size, timestamps, permissions.

tools.name: mcp__filesystem__list_allowed_directories
tools.description: Returns the list of directories this server is allowed to access.
